name: AutomationHealthDashboard

states.name: Dashboard Page Structure
states.description: The dashboard has a page title ('UI Bridge Automation Health' with BarChart3 icon), time range buttons (24h, 7d, 30d), and a refresh button. Below the header, 9 analytics panels are arranged in a responsive grid (2 columns on md+, 1 column on small screens).

states.name: Navigation and Tab Access
states.description: The dashboard is accessible via the 'Automation Health' item in the OBSERVE sidebar group. It appears alongside LLM Analytics, Reflection, and other observability views. The sidebar item shows an Activity icon with green accent (#10B981).

states.name: Time Range Selection Interaction
states.description: Clicking a time range button (24h, 7d, 30d) updates all analytics panels to show data scoped to that window. The active button is highlighted with bg-primary text-primary-foreground. Inactive buttons use bg-muted text-muted-foreground. The refresh button invalidates all React Query caches and re-fetches data from all 13 MCP endpoints.

states.name: Health Score Card Data Display
states.description: Large centered numeric score (0-100) with color-coded label. Breakdown section below shows 5 metrics: Element Success Rate, Regression Rate, Stall Frequency (as percentages), Total Interactions and Unique Elements (as counts). Score = 0.30 * element_success_rate + 0.25 * (1 - regression_rate) + 0.25 * (1 - stall_frequency) + 0.20 base. Backed by GET /ui-bridge/analytics/health-score.

states.name: Health Score Color and Label Semantics
states.description: The score number and label use semantic color coding: green (>= 90, 'Excellent'), yellow (>= 70, 'Good'), orange (>= 50, 'Fair'), red (< 50, 'Poor'). These thresholds communicate automation quality at a glance and match the color coding used throughout the dashboard for success rates.
states.precondition: At least one UI Bridge action has been recorded with task_run_id parameter

states.name: Improvement Recommendations
states.description: Prioritized list of actionable recommendations. Each has a numbered priority circle (1, 2, 3...), color-coded category tag (selectors=blue, performance=orange, annotations=purple, reliability=red), a message describing what to do, and an impact statement explaining why. Categories map to: flaky_element_count > 3 â†’ selectors, stall_count > 2 â†’ performance, unannotated > 5 â†’ annotations, failure_rate > 10% â†’ reliability. Backed by GET /ui-bridge/analytics/recommendations.
states.precondition: At least one recommendation has been generated (requires flaky elements, stalls, or high failure rate)

states.name: Loading, Empty, and Error States
states.description: All 9 panels handle three states consistently: loading (centered muted text), empty (reassuring message specific to each panel), and error (destructive red text with error string). When no interaction data exists, the health score shows 100% (1.0) with 0 interactions. Recommendations show 'No recommendations â€” automation is running well'. Element reliability shows 'No flaky elements detected (all elements have >90% success rate)'. Regressions show 'No regressions detected'.
states.precondition: No UI Bridge actions have been recorded (ui_bridge_events table is empty)

states.name: Analytics Table Data Display
states.description: Three tables display tabular analytics data: Action Baselines (6 columns: Action, Count, Avg/Min/Max ms, Success%), Element Reliability (5 columns: Element, Interactions, Success Rate bar, Confidence, Last Failure), and Annotation Gaps (5 columns: Element, Type, Interactions, Success%, Label). All tables use consistent styling: text-xs headers, hover:bg-muted/50 rows, tabular-nums for numbers, font-mono for element IDs.

states.name: Analytics Chart Data Display
states.description: Four charts visualize analytics data: Failure Taxonomy (error clusters with count badges and element tags), Regression Table (prior/recent/delta success rates in green/red), Stall Frequency (bar chart by pattern type using chart-4 color), and Intervention Effectiveness (stacked bar of Resolved vs Unresolved using chart-2/chart-5 colors with legend). Charts use Recharts with ResponsiveContainer.
states.precondition: At least one stall event with an intervention has been recorded

states.name: Color Coding Semantics
states.description: Consistent color coding across all panels communicates data quality at a glance. Success rates: green >= 95%, yellow >= 80%, red < 80%. Health score: green >= 90, yellow >= 70, orange >= 50, red < 50. Recommendation categories: blue (selectors), orange (performance), purple (annotations), red (reliability). Pattern status: red (active), green (resolved), gray (suppressed). Flaky badge: red bg-red-500/10. Success bar: green/yellow/red fill on muted background.

states.name: Data Freshness and Pipeline Behavior
states.description: Analytics data reflects recent UI Bridge interactions. When actions are performed with ?task_run_id= query parameter on the /ui-bridge/control/element/{id}/action endpoint, they are persisted to ui_bridge_events via spawn_blocking. The dashboard should show non-zero interaction counts within seconds of actions being performed. Changing the time range should filter all panels. The health score should decrease when failures are introduced.
states.precondition: UI Bridge actions were executed with ?task_run_id= query parameter on /ui-bridge/control/element/{id}/action endpoint

states.name: Backend Data Pipeline Architecture
states.description: Architecture: UI Bridge action handlers (mcp/ui_bridge.rs, mcp/sdk_client.rs) persist events to ui_bridge_events table via insert_ui_bridge_event() when ?task_run_id= query param is present. Events flow through 17 SQL query functions in database/ui_bridge_ops.rs, exposed via 13 MCP HTTP endpoints under /ui-bridge/analytics/*. The knowledge graph (reflection/graph_engine.rs) loads UIElement nodes and InteractedWith edges for causal analysis. The stall detector (orchestration_loop/stall_detector.rs) fetches /ui-bridge/control/health-signals to detect UIStuck patterns. Token attribution flows through phase_token_usage.target_app. CTR auto-seeding pushes reliability data to SDK apps on connect.

states.name: Visual Design Consistency
states.description: All panels use bg-card rounded-lg border border-border p-4 container styling. Headings use font-semibold with a Lucide icon. Tables use text-xs text-muted-foreground headers, py-2 px-3 cell padding, hover:bg-muted/50 row highlights, and tabular-nums for numeric alignment. Charts use h-48 height with ResponsiveContainer. The responsive grid uses grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4.
